task: FDD-036 (Learning Methodology Examples, Best-Practice Ledger and the Review-Triage Learning Loop): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Functional design traces to BRU-036-01 to BRU-036-08 and ADR-036: catalog entry and class derivation, ledger entry and adoption rule, triage record and reliability bound, error table.

Three pure standard-library modules (methodology_catalog.py, methodology_ledger.py, review_triage.py), content under examples/methodologies/, the ledger under docs/project-docs, the two policy shapes as actions and profile files under docs/policy-shapes (section 2.4, authority applied at policy initialization), and a package re-export, in the style of lessons_learned.py and tailoring.py.

Reuses autonomy.wilson_lower_bound instead of a new estimator and adds no dependency. Two choices are provisional and recorded as such: min_cases = 5 and counting partial as not verified. The class derivation depends on a state vocabulary that ADR-024 leaves partly open.
Zero storage expansion (ADR-002 Invariant 2), no import of examples into src, no change to a methodology state, and triage stays human with permanent approval (ADR-003 Invariant 6).
